section: Opus code-reviewer on the checker, the conventions file and the tests (all findings fixed in this diff)

review.finding: The JSON-output check was dead code (`if False`), so the --json shape was never asserted.
review.suggestion: Parse the output and assert skills and findings. Fixed.

review.finding: A missing name was never reported although name and description are the two required fields.
review.suggestion: Add a hard name-required limit and check. Fixed.

review.finding: A BOM or trailing space on the closing frontmatter line hid the frontmatter and produced a false hard finding.
review.suggestion: Strip the BOM, find the closing line by strip(). Fixed.

review.finding: A plain path mention inside a reference file did not count as nesting, and a same-named file elsewhere counted as a link.
review.suggestion: Resolve links against their source directory; apply the plain-path rule to references. Fixed.

review.finding: The forward-slash regex had no word boundary.
review.suggestion: Anchor with a word boundary. Fixed.

review.finding: The body limit was inclusive although Anthropic says under 500 lines.
review.suggestion: Report a body of 500 lines or more. Fixed.

review.finding: The 40-line table-of-contents window was a hard-coded number without a reason.
review.suggestion: Move it into the limit with its reason. Fixed.

review.finding: --all with a wrong root printed a misleading message.
